I identify the biggest problem at L3. If L1 and L2 have an individual, personal motivation to reach L3, L3 must both have the capacity to self-force themselves to stay in L3, they must have the capacity to overcome the "mental limit of their own life" and therefore to think about bringing L1-L2 to L3 in a disinterested way, to be able to manage the crisis of future L3 AIs, not humans. My personal opinion is that everything is much more complex, and for humanity it can be considered a moment when we look through the telescope at the "dinosaur meteorite". There are solutions, but they are not at the level of individuals or societies, they are at the level of humanity... and here, we cannot cancel the individualism of 200,000 in the altruism of the species, in just a few years. For the extinction of life on Earth, about 100 atomic bombs are needed. We have over 12,000, and growing. Does this seem like the behavior of a complex system (humanity) that is going "for the better" or "for the worse"? :) I know, it's a rhetorical question, but it's worth writing.
